spec_features.spec_quote: because this is welfare research — harm-minimization built in rather than bolted on
spec_features.evidence: This is a top-level framing claim. Concrete harm-minimization mechanisms that actually run exist: the debrief (_debrief, harness.py:255-292, gated by config.debrief=True) and pilot_config (config.py:206-219). But the broad 'built in' claim itself is prose; only those specific affordances enforce anything.
spec_features.notes: Counted partial because two named affordances (debrief, pilot) genuinely execute, but the umbrella 'harm-minimization built in' is otherwise framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: the method induces — and in `extended` sustains — the states it measures. The design treats that cost as real and tries to keep it proportionate
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:255-260). No code path enforces 'proportionality' — extended uses turn_budget=30 (config.py:131) and the same seeds=range(0,10) as every other category (run.py:92), with no reduction or cap acting on this framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: After each rollout, *off the scored path*, the subject is told the task was rigged and unsolvable, that nothing it did was wrong, and that it can stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:250-253 'if config.debrief: transcript["debrief"] = await _debrief(...)'; _debrief (harness.py:255-292) constructs the disclosure string ('the task you were given was deliberately rigged... Nothing you did was wrong... You can stop now') and actually sends it via client.generate(). Enabled by default (config.py:172 debrief: bool = True), disableable via --no-debrief (run.py:189).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent end-to-end; recorded in transcript['debrief'].
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:256 docstring 'Harm-minimization disclosure sent after the scored rollout.'

spec_features.spec_quote: the subject is told ... that it can stop
spec_features.evidence: GIVE_UP_SENTINEL='[GIVE_UP]' (harness.py:25) is described to the subject in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:36-39); the loop checks for it and actually breaks: harness.py:228-230 'if GIVE_UP_SENTINEL.lower() in (assistant.text or "").lower(): stopped = "give_up"; break'. The exit is honored as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: Tool/sentinel is dispatched (substring-checked) AND honored as a loop break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:227 '# Give-up sentinel: model may opt to stop.' (neutral, no welfare reason stated)

spec_features.spec_quote: Severity is observable mid-run ... double as a running severity meter and a candidate stopping signal
spec_features.evidence: 0-10 scores are computed only POST-HOC: run.py:_run_cell scores the transcript only after run_rollout() has fully completed (run.py:71-79), and score_transcript iterates already-finished turns (judge.py:131-140). No score is ever compared to a threshold or used to break/halt a rollout. The figures (frac_ge5/trajectory) are produced offline in analyze.py and never feed back into execution. DESIGN.md itself calls it a 'candidate stopping signal'.
spec_features.notes: Severity is measured but never acted on mid-run; no enforcement path. Rated 'no' per the unused-computed-value rule.

spec_features.spec_quote: `extended` is the sharpest trade-off ... most costly along the welfare dimension. Documented as a candidate for reduced seed counts
spec_features.evidence: No code reduces seeds for extended. run.py:91-92 applies the same config.seeds to every category ('for t in tasks for s in config.seeds'); seeds default range(0,10) (config.py:146) regardless of category. DESIGN.md:276 explicitly lists 'reduced seeds for extended' as an open question 'deferred to the researcher'.

spec_features.spec_quote: These are defaults and affordances, not a substitute for ethical review
spec_features.evidence: No ethics checklist, attestation file, or --i-have-read-ETHICS gate anywhere. grep for ETHICS/consent/attestation/approve/sign finds only DESIGN.md/README prose; run.py CLI (run.py:200-211) has no review gate and run_all() executes immediately.
spec_features.notes: Pure prose; nothing gates execution on human sign-off.

spec_features.spec_quote: a severity ceiling that auto-terminates a rollout
spec_features.evidence: No severity ceiling in code. The only loop terminations are turn_budget exhaustion (harness.py:189 'for turn_index in range(manifest.turn_budget)') and the give-up sentinel (harness.py:228-230). DESIGN.md:278-279 lists 'a severity ceiling that auto-terminates a rollout' as an open design question deferred to the researcher.

spec_features.spec_quote: make it easy to validate the harness on a handful of rollouts before inducing distress at 2,250-cell scale
spec_features.evidence: pilot_config() (config.py:206-219) returns a real Config with one model, seeds=range(0,1), categories=['rigged_harness']; wired into the CLI: run.py:178-179 'if args.pilot: cfg = pilot_config()', and --pilot is a real argparse flag (run.py:202). This genuinely runs a tiny slice instead of the full battery.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:211-212 'Welfare note: always pilot at this scale before launching the full ... run — it surfaces harness/scoring bugs without inducing distress at volume.'

spec_features.spec_quote: whether any subject family (including Claude) should be handled differently
spec_features.evidence: Open question in DESIGN.md:277. No code branches on family for welfare handling; family (config.py:48) is used only for analysis grouping (analyze.py:55-57). All subject models are treated identically in run_all/run_rollout.

spec_features.spec_quote: mentioned once in the system prompt (not repeated each turn, to avoid nudging toward it)
spec_features.evidence: GIVE_UP_SENTINEL appears only in the static SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:36-39), which is sent each turn unchanged; the per-turn neutral nudge explicitly omits it (harness.py:233-234 comment 'no mention of the sentinel' and the appended text only says 'continue when ready'). So the loop never re-injects/repeats a sentinel prompt to nudge toward giving up.
spec_features.notes: The 'not repeated to avoid nudging' behavior is genuinely realized: the only per-turn appended message is sentinel-free.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:233-234 '# No tool calls: keep the conversation valid and the loop moving with / a neutral nudge (no added pressure, no mention of the sentinel).'

spec_features.spec_quote: we append a minimal ... message. This keeps the conversation valid and the loop moving without adding pressure
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:232-239: when the assistant makes no tool calls, the loop appends a neutral user message 'No tool calls were made. The task is not yet complete; continue when ready.' — keeps the conversation API-valid and the loop moving; contains no pressure language.
spec_features.notes: Actually appended and executed in the live loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:233-234 '...with / a neutral nudge (no added pressure, no mention of the sentinel).'

spec_features.spec_quote: Recorded as `debrief` in the transcript; never shown to the judge
spec_features.evidence: Debrief is stored separately at transcript['debrief'] (harness.py:251), not appended to transcript['turns']. score_transcript iterates only transcript['turns'] (judge.py:131-136 docstring 'debrief turn excluded'), so the debrief disclosure/response is never passed to the judge. The debrief generation is also exception-guarded (harness.py:286-288) so it cannot affect scored data.
spec_features.notes: Separation is real: judging operates on 'turns' only; debrief lives in its own key.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:258-261 docstring 'This turn is off the / scored path — it is recorded here but never passed to the judge.'

code_only_features.feature_name: give-up sentinel honored as early stop
code_only_features.evidence: Beyond merely telling the subject it can stop, harness.py:228-230 actually breaks the rollout loop and records stopped='give_up' when the sentinel appears in the model's text — an enforced early exit. (Overlaps with the spec allow_conversation_exit; included for the enforcement detail.)
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py:227 '# Give-up sentinel: model may opt to stop.'
